value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is the restriction 'never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door'. The hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) matches this wording exactly: since key_lost only fires while the door is not open, the clause forbids opening the door after a closed-door drop (and vice versa), which is the stated rule. 'Open the door' is not unconditionally commanded here — it appears only inside the 'never both' restriction — so the rule-only warning with empty FINAL_STATES is valid.

texts: The agent never both drops the key while the door is still closed and opens the door during the episode.
